devdoc.details: Lives as a standalone immutable contract. Updating shipment plans requires deploying a new instance and updating the ShipmentRoute planContract addresses help in AppStorage.Called via staticcall. New plan getters must be view/pure functions.

getBarnPlan(bytes).details: The Barn cap is the amount of outstanding unfertilized fertilizer.data param is unused data to configure plan details.

getFieldPlan(bytes).details: The Field cap is the amount of outstanding Pods unharvestable pods.

params.data: Encoded uint256 containing the index of the Field to receive the Beans.

getSiloPlan(bytes).details: The Silo has no cap.data param is unused data to configure plan details.
